summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY with embedded firmware experience in bare-metal C on STM32 microcontrollers, FreeRTOS, and UART/I2C/SPI. Built interrupt-driven real-time firmware and custom wavelet filters at BARC; B.E. in Electronics & Telecommunication (digital signal processing, digital electronics) with EAGLE PCB design.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free cursor control integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Designed a custom wavelet bank (alpha-blended sym6+bior3.5) to suppress low-frequency noise; combined with optimized homography stitching and concurrency to achieve a PSNR of 86.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed a Cortex-M4 microcontroller in bare-metal embedded C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1), achieving a deterministic 1 Hz real-time update in 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM; verified in Proteus.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination on an STM32 microcontroller; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override.
Used YOLOv8 on Jetson to track objects, sending control commands to the STM32 over UART.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.
Integrated dual VL53L0X ToF sensors via a TCA9548A I2C mux for contact-aware grasping (gripper close at 25 mm); implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++ driving five servos.
